source_map_meta.description: LLM-manual map graph built tile-by-tile from divided region images and rulebook terrain/connection semantics.
source_map_meta.schema_notes: Nodes are land/sea tiles. City status (`is_city`) is separate from terrain. Each neighbor entry describes source -> neighbor. `border_terrain` is a string or a list of simultaneous first-round terrains, e.g. ["desert", "mountain"], not inferred from node terrain. `has_river` describes a river route; `river_crossing` is a directional combat crossing. `naval_facilities` and matching `naval_facility_ids` are paired physical instances. Repeated types with distinct IDs are separate facilities; the same ID on two coast edges is one shared facility. Intrinsic facilities use `node_facilities` / `node_facility_ids`. Reviewed direct land narrow crossings have `narrow_crossing`, printed unit capacity in the legacy-named `narrow_crossings`, and `narrow_crossing_sea_zones` for all blocking seas. They are constrained crossings under rule 1.9, not unrestricted land adjacency. `railway_connection` is a reciprocal boolean regardless of the number of drawn tracks; `gauge_change` remains separate. Rule 10.6.2 (p. 67) bombs all railroads on a border together. Damage is mutable game state, not encoded by the static rail presence flag.
warnings: This file is manually transcribed from the map image and is intended for iterative RL environment development.
Some IPP and terrain assignments remain best-effort where small labels were visually ambiguous.

Canadian map-edge adjacency Mackenzie-Keewatin and Alberta-Saskatchewan-Manitoba is user-approved; the existing Alberta-Manitoba railway remains unverified. Other Canadian seam links and Ottawa ordinary sea adjacency remain unaudited.
Alaska, Southeast Alaska, New England, and P1 were added as endpoints for the Canadian audit; their remaining non-Canadian connections are not fully transcribed.

The China theatre audit retains unresolved Kobdo-Novosibirsk adjacency, southern Sinkiang/Himalayan contacts, and Tannu Tuva identity/home-country membership. Sinkiang-to-Eastern Kazakhstan river_crossing remains an unverified false default.

Bengal and Turkestan were added as endpoints for the China audit; their non-China connections are not fully transcribed. Annam-Tonkin-to-Kwangtung jungle+mountain entry is an image interpretation, not an official edge ruling.

P18 and P26 were added only as P16 boundary endpoints; their other connections are not audited. South Sakhalin and Kurile node identity/terrain remain unaudited despite their reviewed narrow crossings to Hokkaido.

On reviewed direct land crossings, narrow_crossings is the printed unit capacity (legacy field name), not a count of crossings. narrow_crossing_sea_zones lists the seas that can block that crossing. Unaudited legacy coast/sea narrow flags are not sufficient movement rules.
Naval facility type/ID arrays are paired instances, not sets of types: Honshu has two separate major_shipyard IDs on P15. Count shared physical IDs only once across access edges.

scenario_manifest.artifact_scope: Map projection and campaign specification only; playable setup and rules are not implemented by this manifest.

campaign.setup_basis: Official July 1936 starting pieces on included tiles only; off-map pieces omitted. M0 records 103 deployed units and 3 setup factories separately from the static map. Unlocated Japanese national queues remain unresolved and are not deployed.

m0_specification.treasury_authority: Theatre adjustment user-approved; exact min(official starting IPP, retained direct land IPP) is a documented scenario derivation. Controlled and unaligned minors receive zero cash.

agent_control.notes: Alliance agents do not merge nations, automatically align warlords, or automatically declare war.

interpretations: Treasury and paid construction use the same 0.1 asset weight as completed units/facilities; this cash/construction weighting is an explicit interpretation, not a separately confirmed choice.
wealth_objective.accounting: Count each physical facility once by ID; replace paid construction value with completed asset value on completion, never count both. Preserve national ledgers when aggregating a side.

known_limitations: Tannu Tuva is excluded by user choice; its unresolved national identity remains a global-map issue and does not block this scenario.

The map itself does not contain starting units, setup factories, construction queues or mutable diplomacy. M0 files are source-audited specifications, not a playable initial state; pending decisions are listed in their contract.
Hokkaido's P7 port access is deliberately absent because P7 is outside this closed map.
Outside neighbors and any facilities carried solely on those edges are removed. Cut-edge provenance is not a movement, supply or reinforcement interface.
Rules whose prerequisites exist only outside this theatre are inactive in this profile; no external events or off-map income are supplied implicitly.

notes: Static map projection only; not a playable scenario or initial unit setup.
Internal node/edge data is unchanged; all excluded neighbors are removed.
boundary_cuts is provenance only and must not create movement or supply routes.
